entry.name: Huy Nguyen
entry.department: Center for DNA Damage and Repair, Department of Radiation Oncology

evidence.currentRole: https://www.dana-farber.org/research/integrative-research/dna-damage-and-repair/team — "Huy Nguyen, ALM, MS"; "CDDR Staff Scientist"; identifies him as a computational biologist in the D'Andrea laboratory and associated scientist at Broad. Live HTTP 200 retrieved with Python requests; web open timed out. Career staff position, separated from trainee roles; prior Whitehead/Broad genome-mapping work is described on the same page.
evidence.doctorateOrPapers: Publication route; employer bio lists two masters degrees, so no doctorate proposed. Two distinct identity-resolved papers within 2023-11-14–2026-11-14: (1) The splicing factor CCAR1 regulates the Fanconi anemia/BRCA pathway, Molecular Cell, first published 2024-07-17, DOI 10.1016/j.molcel.2024.06.031, PMID 39025073, https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39025073/ ; (2) CHAMP1 complex directs heterochromatin assembly and promotes homology-directed DNA repair, Nature Communications, 2025-02-17, DOI 10.1038/s41467-025-56834-6, PMID 39962076, https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-025-56834-6 . Europe PMC live core records verified both full author lists and Huy Nguyen's Dana-Farber radiation-oncology affiliation: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=DOI:10.1016/j.molcel.2024.06.031&format=json&resultType=core and https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=DOI:10.1038/s41467-025-56834-6&format=json&resultType=core . Matching D'Andrea coauthors and exact employer/unit resolve identity; https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE242781 additionally identifies Huy as the Dana-Farber/D'Andrea data contact. CHAMP1 dataset PXD055109 identifies huy_nguyen@dfci.harvard.edu, matching the current employer page. A third paper, DOI 10.1073/pnas.2525144122 (2026), was also verified in Europe PMC.
evidence.vietnameseSignal: Vietnamese given name Huy together with Nguyen, spelled on the live Dana-Farber team page. No reconstructed diacritics or expanded name.
evidence.dedup: Ran npm run find-roster-matches -- "Huy Nguyen" with --url for the current employer page, Nature paper, PubMed 41481470 and 39025073, ORCID 0000-0002-4424-1047 (obtained from paper metadata), and GEO GSE242781. Fourteen name-only matches, no identity-URL match: vp-0024, vp-0068, vp-0171, vp-0243, vp-0289, vp-0800, vp-0872, vp-1585, vp-2104, vp-2597, vp-3024, vp-3190, vp-3195, vp-3212. Inspected every matched roster record. Their distinct subjects/degree histories (CS theory, mathematics, management, acoustics, tissue engineering, strategy, clinical orthopaedics, marketing, geometric analysis, liver transplantation, embedded systems, spatial-genomics doctorate at Dartmouth, quantum computing, and Hitachi measurement systems) differ from this long-serving Whitehead/Broad genome-mapping computational biologist with Toronto/Harvard masters degrees and D'Andrea cancer-repair publications. Especially vp-3190 is Huy Q. Nguyen, Dartmouth PhD 2015, not this person. gh issue list --state all --search found unrelated same-name hits; read relevant batch bodies, including #1102 (Amazon), #1104, #329 and #1114. Not in already-proposed.txt.

evidence.currentRole: https://www.dana-farber.org/find-a-doctor/paul-l-nguyen — "Senior Physician"; "Director, Genitourinary Radiation Oncology". Live HTTP 200 opened with web and requests. The profile describes leadership of the FORMULA-509, PREDICT-RT and ENZARAD trials and the continuing clinical-research role. Also holds a Harvard Medical School professorship and Brigham and Women's Hospital appointment; these are one person, not additional candidates.
evidence.doctorateOrPapers: Clinical-research MD exception: the same official profile explicitly states MD from Harvard Medical School and an active prostate-cancer research program. It also lists numerous distinct 2024 research papers, including Insulin resistance during androgen deprivation therapy in men with prostate cancer (Cancer, 2024-06-16) and Long-Term Analysis of NRG Oncology RTOG 0415 (J Clin Oncol, 2024-07-10). No PhD or degree year inferred; the MD is intentionally not placed in phdInstitution.
evidence.vietnameseSignal: Vietnamese middle/given name Linh, beyond surname alone. Full name Paul Linh Nguyen is visible on the opened biography https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paul_L._Nguyen (Born field), matching the Dana-Farber radiation oncologist. Harvard Catalyst also indexes him as Paul Linh Nguyen, M.D. at https://connects.catalyst.harvard.edu/profiles/display/Person/3917/Network/ResearchAreas/categories ; that Harvard page could not be fetched live (cache miss), so the opened biography supplies the explicit expanded name. Do not reconstruct vietnameseName.
evidence.dedup: Ran npm run find-roster-matches for both "Paul L. Nguyen" and "Paul Linh Nguyen" with the Dana-Farber profile, opened biography and Harvard coauthor-map identity URL. Initials search found vp-0256 Christopher Paul Nguyen (management, University of New Mexico). Full-name search found vp-0372 (languages), vp-0677 (finance), vp-1951 (business), vp-2234 (biomaterials/dental engineering) and vp-2285 (dental medicine). All are different people by subject, title and institution; no identity-URL match. gh issue list --state all --search with Paul and Nguyen found unrelated name/context matches and no proposal titled for this radiation oncologist. Not in already-proposed.txt.
